summary: A BESS is utility-scale when designed for market participation or grid services and not primarily intended to serve on-site load. Behind-the-meter systems serving on-site consumption are distributed generation and exempt.
text: Residential, commercial, and industrial systems installed behind the customer meter or serving on-site consumption shall be considered distributed generation and are exempt from this definition.
notes: Directly opposite to Hillsboro's accessory BESS definition. Adjacency: Calyx founder is CEO/CTO of an entity operating in this category. See /adjacency.
